comparison_button_fix_summary.root_cause_1_addressed: openSkuCrossPlatformRadar lacked direct mapping between shelf SKU IDs (DORM_SKU_FEED_xx) and CROSS_PLATFORM_SKU_TRIPLETS.matchKeys.
comparison_button_fix_summary.root_cause_2_addressed: openSkuCrossPlatformRadar previously opened an unstyled secondary modal (#jayt-sku-cross-radar-modal) lacking high z-index and body scroll locking.
comparison_button_fix_summary.root_cause_3_addressed: Parameter naming mismatch between caller and computeCrossPlatformRadar caused drop into generic fallback.

remediation_deliverables.shelf_sku_to_triplet_map: Implemented O(1) hash map covering all 20 shelf products (DORM_SKU_FEED_01..20) and legacy dorm IDs.
remediation_deliverables.expanded_match_keys: All 10 triplets enriched with exact shelf SKU IDs, variant IDs, and merchant identifiers.
remediation_deliverables.button_signature: onclick='triggerJaytSensoryFeedback(event); openSkuCrossPlatformRadar("SKU_ID", "TITLE", PRICE, "PLATFORM")' with safe fallback arguments.
remediation_deliverables.touch_target: Enforced min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; across all shelf CTA buttons.
remediation_deliverables.modal_styling: Styled #jayt-voucher-scanner-modal with z-index: 99999 !important; display: flex !important; and document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'.
remediation_deliverables.close_mechanisms: closeVoucherScannerModal restores document.body.style.overflow = '' and attaches listeners to Escape key, backdrop click, and ✕ button.
remediation_deliverables.transparency_rule: Strict enforcement of 'Thật 100% hoặc Không hiển thị' (🔒 Chưa Có Link Chính Hãng when competitor lacks Mall PDP; zero search redirect spam).
